name: pokerplan
description: Real-time Scrum planning poker — NestJS, Socket.IO, Prisma, Next.js
author: Lalit Kumar Rajak (https://github.com/rajak312)

scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @pokerplan/shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @pokerplan/api
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @pokerplan/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w @pokerplan/shared" "npm run dev -w @pokerplan/api" "npm run dev -w @pokerplan/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pokerplan/shared && npm run build -w @pokerplan/api && npm run build -w @pokerplan/web
